events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in counterculture history, took place in Bethel, New York from August 15 to 18, 1969.

angles.name: Peace, Love & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the mud, the music, and the magic. What's your ultimate Woodstock track?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, passed away at Graceland on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: King of Rock and Roll
angles.copy: Still shaking up the airwaves. Remembering the King, Elvis Presley, today.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and died six days later on September 13, 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since we lost a voice that shaped a generation. Remembering the enduring impact of Tupac Shakur.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix tragically passed away in London from barbiturate-related asphyxia on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Still sounds as revolutionary today. Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', featuring iconic tracks and its famous cover, in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: That zebra crossing. That album. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' is 57 years old. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Frontwoman
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Our kid is another year older! Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic anthem "Imagine" as a single in the UK on October 24, 1975.

angles.name: Imagine the Impact
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message that resonates today.

events.title: The iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first-generation iPod, revolutionising portable music players, on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: Rewind to the iPod
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? The original iPod is 25! How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate 007 theme tune? Let us know!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary musician and peace activist John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Imagine a World
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Ministry of Silly Walks
angles.copy: Celebrating the wonderfully absurd John Cleese on his 87th birthday! What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonders
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered the 'White Album'. So much to unpack on this double LP!

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on November 24, 1991, leaving behind an unparalleled musical legacy.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since the world lost a true icon. Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury today.
